ratios.quote: XPEL shall not allow its Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio to exceed 3.50 to 1.00
XPEL shall not allow its Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio to be less than 3.00 to 1.00

parsed.notes: The filing does not disclose actual ratio values. It states only the covenant limits and that the Company was in compliance with all debt covenants as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025. No amounts were outstanding under the Credit Agreement. The Term Loan with PNC has identical covenants (3.50x maximum leverage, 3.00x minimum interest coverage), but they become effective only after the Wells Fargo Credit Agreement ceases to be in effect, so they are not listed separately. Leverage-based pricing grids for the margin and commitment fee are excluded.
